intro.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
intro.text: Hi Jin! Welcome to Meridian, our home on Mars. A big dust storm is coming. First, check the computer inside. Then we will get ready together.

diagnosis.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
diagnosis.text: Uh oh. Dust is covering our solar panels. And the spare battery is empty. Let's clean the panels, then grab the battery from the rover.

panel-clean.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
panel-clean.text: Nice! More sunlight is reaching that panel. More sunlight means more power for our air machine.

solar-complete.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
solar-complete.text: All three panels are clean. Great job! Now get the spare battery. It is in the back of the rover.

battery.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
battery.text: Got the battery! Let's carry it to the power box.

install.speaker: Jin Park · Engineer
install.text: The battery is in. Now turn the three plugs to show one, two, three. Then press connect.

repair.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
repair.text: The power is working again! Go back to the computer. You get to choose. Save extra air, or keep our science experiment running?

life.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
life.text: We saved extra air. Now everyone has plenty. The storm is here, Jin. Go to the door!

research.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
research.text: The experiment keeps running. But we have less spare air now. Hurry inside. The storm is here!

storm.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
storm.text: The storm is here! It is hard to see. Stop working outside. Follow the marker to the door and come inside.

shelter.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
shelter.text: You made it inside! These water tanks protect our beds. Now use the console to close the door tight.

sealed.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
sealed.text: The door is sealed. All four of us are safe inside. Let's wait for the storm to pass. Then send a message home.

prepared.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
prepared.text: Meridian calling Earth! All four of us are safe. The panels are clean and the power works. We saved extra air too. Getting ready early really helped!

survived.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
survived.text: Meridian calling Earth. We are all safe! But we used up most of our extra supplies. Next time, let's get more ready before the storm.

evacuated.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
evacuated.text: Meridian calling Earth. We have to leave the base for now. The air machine needs more power. We will try again, and we will learn from today.

elena.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
elena.text: Do one job at a time. Check the computer first. It tells you what is wrong. I will keep the crew ready to come inside.

amara.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
amara.text: Our air machine needs power. Clean panels help while the Sun shines. The battery helps when dust blocks the Sun. We need both!

luca.speaker: Luca Moreau · Medic
luca.text: Feeling rushed? Take a slow breath. Check each plug carefully. And think before you give away our extra air.

water.speaker: Amara Okafor · Biologist
water.text: This water is for drinking. Water also blocks space radiation. So these tanks protect us while we sleep. Water has two jobs here!
